gas.cleanupReserve: every main-phase send must leave, at the current gas price and both under the cap and in the wallet, 13000000 gas for each cleanup transaction the run could need if it stopped right after that send (per open leg a grant and up to 3 guarded closes, a revoke per pool, a withdrawal, an allowance reset; at most 12 for this plan), plus the worst-case fee of any unresolved transaction

bounds.softLossStop: SOFT stopping threshold, not a loss cap: E_total is checked after each opening order and after the reduction; once it is found below 45 USDso (a 15 USDso loss) the run stops and unwinds. Prices can move between checks and the unwind itself pays spread and slippage, so the realised loss can exceed 15 USDso; it cannot exceed the 60 USDso deposited

execution.refusal: a run that stops before its first signature (failed preflight, read failure, a step that would revert in simulation) exits 1 and runs no cleanup, so it never touches collateral, allowances or positions it did not create
execution.unknownTransactions: every transaction is persisted (hash, nonce, intent) before broadcast and resolved before anything else is sent, never re-sent. Only a canonical receipt settles it; it counts as not included only when the node rejected it or the transaction that consumed its nonce was located and is a different one. A failed lookup or a bare nonce increase leaves it UNKNOWN, with its worst-case fee still reserved; the run then stops with exit 40 and is resumed with --resume
